thread:
incident-bot: Pager: Possible cross-tenant traffic detected for customer AcroBio (VPC vpc-8f3b), dedicated pool kp-ded-07. Alert: KV prefix mixing (acct: prefixes) observed in responses. Severity: P1. Link: https://ops.redwood/internal/incidents/2357778888

Emily (SRE): I'm on it. What was the observed symptom? Which path showed cross-tenant reads?

Michael (Infra): We saw a GET on kv-07 that returned keys from two different tenants in one response. Sample log: 
```
2026-03-14T21:42:01Z kv-07 GET /kv?prefix=acct: | resp_keys: [acct:acro/123, acct:zephyr/999]
```

Rajesh (Oncall): Paging infra. Pulling router/table state now. Suspect route import or bridge-namespace leak. Checking iptables & route-importer.

Dana - Customer Success: AcroBio just opened a support ticket saying they observed "unexpected ids" in a dataset around 21:41. Holding external comms until we have scope.

Michael (Infra): Found a deploy earlier that created a static route for the dedicated pool: `10.12.0.0/16 -> kp-ded-07` but it looks like it was accidentally advertised into the main routing table by route-importer after a label change. Dump: 
```
$ ip route show table 420
10.12.0.0/16 dev br-ded-07 proto static
```
It appears route-importer imported table 420 into main due to missing label guard.

Emily (SRE): Mitigation plan: remove leaked route from relay hosts, isolate kp-ded-07 from global overlay, stop route-importer global sync; restart in canary. Can someone run `ip route del 10.12.0.0/16` on relay-41?

Rajesh (Oncall): Running it now.
```
relay-41$ sudo ip route del 10.12.0.0/16
```

incident-bot: Action logged: route removed by Rajesh at 2026-03-14T21:45:22Z. KV-prefix flush scheduled.

Michael (Infra): Flushing KV caches for kp-ded-07 and starting a targeted scan across last 30m.
```
$ ./kv-scan --pool kp-ded-07 --since '-30m' > /tmp/kv_scan.txt
Found 27 mixed-prefix responses, saved to /tmp/forensics/kv_mixed_27.json
```

SecOps Bot: Forensics checklist updated: preserve /var/log/kv-*.log, export iptables and `ip route` from relay-41, snapshot dedicated pool instances, collect route-importer logs. Case created: RED-INC-2026-2357778888.

Dana - Customer Success: Drafting hold message to AcroBio: "We've detected a routing misconfiguration affecting your VPC. We're mitigating and will follow up with scope. No confirmed data exfil at this time." Will send once we lock scope. :white_check_mark:

Emily (SRE): Michael — can you check flow logs for egress from kp-ded-07 to other customer CIDRs? Need to know which tenants may have seen traffic.

Michael (Infra): Flow logs show 12 flows from kp-ded-07 to 10.9.0.0/16 (Zephyr) between 21:40-21:46. Sample entry: 
```
SRC=kp-ded-07.10.12.4 DST=10.9.4.22 proto=TCP dport=8443 ts=2026-03-14T21:44:12Z
```
Likely window of exposure ~ 21:38-21:46.

Rajesh (Oncall): Handoff to Michael for remediation & evidence collection. I'm heading out for a quick break. Michael, you're primary.

Michael (Infra): Taking it. Immediate actions:
- Suspend route-importer global sync (done)
- Revoke overlay egress for kp-ded-07 (done)
- Snapshot kp-ded-07 instances (in progress)
- Export kv logs and run regex search for tenant identifiers across snapshots (in progress)

SecOps Bot: Legal & Compliance notified. Please preserve chain of custody. Eng-incident channel alerted for postmortem timeline.

Dana - Customer Success: AcroBio asked for an ETA on a scoped incident report. Suggest initial scope in 2 hours. I'll coordinate comms.

Emily (SRE): Root cause trace: route-importer change in 21:38 deploy introduced label handling bug. Commit: 6ad1f9b. Plan: rollback to previous commit and add label guard unit test.

Michael (Infra): Rollback applied at 21:49. Observability: mixed-prefix responses stopped after the route deletion; last mixed response at 21:46. Forensics snapshots saved to /mnt/forensics/RED-INC-2026-2357778888.

Rajesh (Oncall): Running connectivity checks post-mitigation: `kv-get` from zephyr to confirm acro keys not visible, and ping tests across tenant subnets.

Emily (SRE): Evidence collection status: snapshots + kv-scan in repo. Current status: mitigation successful; confirmed transient cross-tenant reads during 21:38-21:46 window. Next steps: deep scan to determine persistence, notify Legal if any PII found, customer communication, schedule full postmortem.

Dana - Customer Success: I'll send the hold message now and promise an initial scope in 2 hours. Will attach current timeline and next steps.

Michael (Infra): Created JIRA RED-1234 for remediation work (config lint rule for route-importer + integration test).

incident-bot: Incident moved to mitigated state at 2026-03-14T22:05:10Z. Root cause: route-importer incorrectly importing dedicated-pool routes into main table when label guard absent.

Emily (SRE): Thanks everyone. Handoff to eng-runtime and security for long-term fixes & final scope. Michael will remain oncall for follow-up for 2 hours. Handoff complete. :handshake:
